beats.say: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on 26 October, upgrading ChatGPT and Codex right away.
TechCrunch says OpenAI also launched GPT-6.1 Sol at DevDay, noting it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra while costing less.
Ars Technica reports that another planned version was cancelled because of safety and alignment concerns.
Which AI model do you rely on most for your daily coding work?
